say:0:1320901001:0.text: Naum, where did you run off to? It's getting dark—come home already!

say:2:1320903002:0.text: Yes, I'm looking for my son, Naum. He's eight years old. Have you seen him, by any chance?

say:9:1320903008:0.source_cn: 你们听说过那句准则吗？“不要进入野外的夜晚”，否则就会...

say:15:1320903014:0.source_cn: 不用顾虑这一点！我们的主人是很厉害的魔法师，绝对不会出事的！

say:17:1320903016:0.source_cn: 那……那我只能先谢谢你们了！请一定要找到瑙姆啊！

say:19:1320903010:1.female: I'm certain. He told me before he left.

say:20:1320903011:0.source_cn: 那我们就再过去看看吧！说不定瑙姆刚才只是没注意到你去找他了。

choice:12:1:2.female: Are you sure he went there?

choice:3:1:2.male: Did you two have an argument?
choice:3:1:2.female: Did you two have an argument?

say:1:1320905001:0.source_cn: 喂，你们几个，这么晚了还待在墓园里干嘛？不知道野外晚上...

say:7:1320905005:0.text: So this is what a tomb guardian's like! No wonder the books say they're unique to the Duchy of Whiteridge.
say:7:1320905005:0.source_cn: 原来这就是巡墓人呀……难怪书上都说巡墓人是白山公国特有...

say:8:1320905006:0.source_cn: 巡墓人先生，我们正在寻找一个八九岁左右的小男孩，你有没...

say:9:1320905007:0.text: You mean one of those kids who sneak in to play adventurer? They only come during the day and leave before dark. They're usually gone by now.
say:9:1320905007:0.source_cn: 你说的是那些时不时跑来冒险的小孩？他们只会在白天过来，...

choice_prompt:11:1320905008.text: Hold on, are you saying there's a child here that hasn't gone home yet?
choice_prompt:11:1320905008.source_cn: 怎么，你们要找的那孩子没回去？

say:12:1320905009:0.source_cn: 没回家……那他能去哪？墓园就这么大，根本没地方躲藏。

say:13:1320905010:0.text: ... Oh, I just remembered. I was <style="highlight">outside the cemetery</style> earlier and saw some <style="highlight">footprints</style>. They looked like a kid's. Why don't you follow them?

choice:11:1:2.text: Why else would we be here?
choice:11:1:2.source_cn: 要不然我们干嘛来找他？
choice:11:1:2.male: Why else would we be here?
choice:11:1:2.female: Why else would we be here?

say:0:1320907001:0.text: There are more footprints here! But they look kind of strange...
say:0:1320907001:0.source_cn: 这里的脚印变多了！后覆盖上去的脚印也有点奇怪……

say:1:1320907002:0.text: Could the child have been targeted by the undead?
say:1:1320907002:0.source_cn: 瑙姆……他该不会是被活死人盯上了吧？

say:0:1320908001:0.text: The footprints end here! We need to hurry!

say:0:1320914001:0.text: Naum, stop running! Your mom's waiting for you at home!
say:0:1320914001:0.source_cn: 瑙姆，别跑了！你妈妈还在家里等你回去！

say:1:1320918001:0.source_cn: 你们来得正好。这就是你们要找的那孩子吧？赶紧带他回家吧。

say:21:1320920016:1.source_cn: 我和女儿、和丈夫一起找了很久，都没能找到他的尸骨……那...

say:23:1320920018:0.source_cn: 可我死了之后，却被葬在这座远离镇子的墓园里……在这里，...

say:24:1320920019:0.source_cn: 所以你想回到镇上，在那里等待你儿子的灵魂归来？

say:29:1320920023:1.text: Thank you... My name is Ksenia. Please, move my tombstone and coffin to the temple burial grounds in Cedartown...
say:29:1320920023:1.source_cn: 谢谢你们……我的名字是克谢尼娅，请你们将我的墓碑和棺材...

choice:26:1:2.female: Naum, shall we do this together?

say:1:1320921001:0.text: So, did you find that spirit?

say:3:1320921002:0.text: We did! She asked us to move her grave to Cedartown, and we promised to help her.
say:3:1320921002:0.source_cn: 找到啦！而且我们还答应帮她完成心愿，把她的坟墓从这里迁...

say:6:1320921005:0.text: *Sigh* Look, let me be upfront. In Cedartown, we have a tradition of burying the dead together so us tomb guardians can keep an eye on them. If any undead show up, we can deal with them fast.
say:6:1320921005:0.source_cn: 唉，说实话吧。雪松镇的本地习俗就是把死者葬在一起，方便...

say:7:1320921006:0.source_cn: 至于镇上的教堂墓地，那周围有不少民居。为了防止那片墓地...

say:9:1320921007:1.text: Wait, does that mean we can't move the spirit lady's grave there?
say:9:1320921007:1.source_cn: 这么说来，幽灵大婶就不能安葬在那边了……？

say:10:1320921008:1.text: Sir, isn't there any way around this? She's not an undead, she just wants to be near her son!
say:10:1320921008:1.source_cn: 巡墓人叔叔，就不能破例一次吗？幽灵大婶不是活死人，她只...

say:12:1320921010:0.text: ...Wait. If she's already a spirit, isn't it impossible for her to turn into an undead?
say:12:1320921010:0.source_cn: ……等等。既然她已经是幽灵，是不是就没可能再变成活死人了？

say:14:1320921011:0.text: Hmm, technically, yes. Once someone becomes a spirit, that means their soul has left their body entirely.
say:14:1320921011:0.source_cn: 唔，从理论上来说是的。毕竟变成幽灵就代表灵魂已经彻底脱...

say:15:1320921012:1.text: If that's the case... fine, you can move her grave.
say:15:1320921012:1.source_cn: 既然这样……那好吧，你们就把她的坟墓迁过去吧。

say:16:1320921013:0.text: But I'll need her name for the records, just to make sure everything's in order.
say:16:1320921013:0.source_cn: 你们知道她的名字吧？我得记录一下，免得后面又出什么问题。

say:17:1320921014:0.source_cn: 当然知道，幽灵大婶叫克谢尼娅！

say:18:1320921015:1.text: Ksenia, huh... There are at least three graves here with that name.
say:18:1320921015:1.source_cn: 克谢尼娅……我记得这墓园里至少有三个人都叫这个名字。

say:20:1320921016:0.text: What?! How do we know which one is hers, then?
say:20:1320921016:0.source_cn: 啊？！这、这我们要怎么确定哪个才是我们要找的人啊？！

say:21:1320921017:0.text: <style="highlight">Check the epitaphs</style>. Families usually make them unique to avoid confusion.

say:23:1320921004:0.text: Well, it is allowed. It's just that...
say:23:1320921004:0.male: Well, it is allowed. It's just that...
say:23:1320921004:0.female: Well, it is allowed. It's just that...

say:1:1320922001:0.text: Chippy's found three gravestones marked with "Ksenia"!
say:1:1320922001:0.source_cn: 满满找过了，墓园里只有三座克谢尼娅的墓碑。

say:2:1320922002:0.text: This one says, "May you be reunited with your valiant son." This must be hers!
say:2:1320922002:0.source_cn: 看起来，这块写着“愿你与你英勇的儿子团聚”的墓碑应该就...

say:3:1320922003:0.text: However, this gravestone is severely damaged, and the earth above the grave has collapsed. The coffin is probably in poor condition; we'll need a new one.
say:3:1320922003:0.source_cn: 不过，这块墓碑很残破，墓地上方的泥土也塌陷了，棺材很可...

say:4:1320922004:0.text: There might be unused coffins in the cemetery. Let's <style="highlight">ask the tomb guardian</style>!
say:4:1320922004:0.source_cn: 墓园里应该有没用过的棺材！我们去<style=high...

say:1:1320923001:1.text: Sir, the spirit lady's coffin is in terrible condition. We need a new one, do you have any here?
say:1:1320923001:1.source_cn: 巡墓人大叔，幽灵大婶的棺材腐烂得很严重，需要一口新棺材...

say:2:1320923002:1.text: No, we don't just keep empty coffins lying around.
say:2:1320923002:1.source_cn: 没有，墓园里没事放那么多空棺材干嘛。

say:3:1320923003:1.text: But there's plenty of <style="highlight">hard pine</style> growing nearby. It's sturdy and moisture-resistant. If you gather some wood, I'll make a new coffin for you.
say:3:1320923003:1.source_cn: 不过附近倒是有挺多<style=highlight>硬...

say:4:1320923004:1.text: Wow, really? Thanks! Let's go get that wood right away!
say:4:1320923004:1.source_cn: 哇，谢谢大叔！我们现在就去收集木材！

say:0:1320924001:0.text: This much should be enough, right?
say:0:1320924001:0.source_cn: 收集到的木材够多了，带给巡墓人让他制作棺材吧。

say:1:1320925001:0.text: Sir, we've brought the wood! Is this enough?
say:1:1320925001:0.source_cn: 大叔，我们收集到你要的硬松木了！这些应该足够了吧？

say:2:1320925002:1.text: Looks good. Give me a little time, making coffin isn't quick work.
say:2:1320925002:1.source_cn: 差不多刚好。行了，你们等一会吧，制作棺材得要一点时间。

say:3:1320925003:1.text: *Sigh* What a long night this has been...

narration:4:1320925004:0.text: After some time and hard work, the tomb guardian finishes the new coffin and helps you open Ksenia's grave.
narration:4:1320925004:0.source_cn: 一阵忙碌后，巡墓人终于做好了新棺材，并且帮你们打开了克...

say:5:1320925005:1.text: You were right, the old coffin really couldn't be salvaged.
say:5:1320925005:1.source_cn: 你们判断的没错，这口旧棺材确实没法再用了。

say:6:1320925006:1.text: I'll take care of transferring the remains to the new coffin. You can gather her belongings and grave goods. It's best to <style="highlight">pack everything in this bag</style> for easy transport.
say:6:1320925006:1.source_cn: 我负责把尸骨挪到新棺材里，这些遗物和随葬品就交给你们收...

say:0:1320926001:0.text: Got everything? Make sure nothing's left behind.
say:0:1320926001:0.source_cn: 都收拾好了，没落下什么东西吧？

say:1:1320926002:0.text: It's all here! Let's bring Ksenia's belongings to the temple burial grounds in town.
say:1:1320926002:0.source_cn: 嗯，我们赶快把克谢尼娅的东西都送到镇上的教堂墓地吧。

cinematic_dialogue:2:1320911001:.text: Are you a mage? That's so cool!
cinematic_dialogue:2:1320911001:.male: Are you a mage? That's so cool!
cinematic_dialogue:2:1320911001:.female: Are you a mage? That's so cool!

cinematic_dialogue:2:1320911002:.text: Huh?! That spirit is running away!

say:5:1320912001:0.text: Magister, that spirit fled toward the cemetery! We should go after it!
say:5:1320912001:0.source_cn: 主人，那个幽灵好像逃往墓园的方向了！我们得赶快追上去，...
say:5:1320912001:0.male: Magister, that spirit fled toward the cemetery! We should go after it!
say:5:1320912001:0.female: Magister, that spirit fled toward the cemetery! We should go after it!

say:7:1320912002:0.text: Wait, we can't leave Naum here alone!
say:7:1320912002:0.source_cn: 等一下！满满，我们不能把瑙姆一个人留在这里。

say:9:1320912003:0.text: How do you know my name?!

say:10:1320912004:1.text: Because you didn't come home and your mother's worried sick! She even risked running into the undead to look for you.
say:10:1320912004:1.source_cn: 还不是因为你一直没回家，你妈妈担心得要命，冒着被活死人...

say:11:1320912005:0.text: But don't worry, we promised her we'd help, so she's back home now.
say:11:1320912005:0.source_cn: 不过你别担心，我们答应帮她找到你，已经把她劝回家了。

say:14:1320912010:1.text: I accidentally fell asleep in the woods... A spirit lady woke me up.
say:14:1320912010:1.source_cn: 我、我不小心在树林里睡着了，是幽灵大婶把我叫醒的。

say:15:1320912011:0.text: By then, it was dark, and she was worried I'd be in danger. She appeared and tried to help me get home, but we ran into the undead on the way...
say:15:1320912011:0.source_cn: 当时天黑了，她担心我会碰到活死人，所以才现身叫醒我，想...

say:16:1320912012:1.text: So it seems that spirit didn't have bad intentions after all!
say:16:1320912012:1.source_cn: 这么听下来，那个幽灵应该不是坏人。

say:17:1320912013:1.text: Yes, spirits and the undead are different. Most spirits are just people who couldn't fulfill their wishes while they were alive, so they linger as spirits.
say:17:1320912013:1.source_cn: 毕竟幽灵和活死人不一样。他们大多是因为生前的心愿没能完...

say:18:1320912014:0.text: And they eventually fade away, so it's rare for them to lose their sanity. Kindhearted ghosts aren't as uncommon as you think!
say:18:1320912014:0.source_cn: 而且，幽灵会随着时间逐渐消散，所以很少出现失去理智的情...

say:19:1320912015:1.text: People with unfulfilled wishes turn into spirits... That actually makes sense! No wonder that lady seemed so troubled!
say:19:1320912015:1.source_cn: 没实现心愿的人会变成幽灵……原来是这样！难怪幽灵大婶心...

say:20:1320912016:0.text: Mister, will you come with me to find her? I want to help her fulfill her wish!
say:20:1320912016:0.male: Mister, will you come with me to find her? I want to help her fulfill her wish!
say:20:1320912016:0.female: Miss, will you come with me to find her? I want to help her fulfill her wish!

choice_prompt:21:1320912016.text: Mister, will you come with me to find her? I want to help her fulfill her wish!
choice_prompt:21:1320912016.source_cn: 魔法师<male>哥哥</male><female>姐姐</female>，你们可以陪我去找幽灵大婶吗？我想替她实现心愿！
choice_prompt:21:1320912016.male: Mister, will you come with me to find her? I want to help her fulfill her wish!
choice_prompt:21:1320912016.female: Miss, will you come with me to find her? I want to help her fulfill her wish!

say:22:1320912017:1.text: B-but if I don't go now, I might never see her again...
say:22:1320912017:1.source_cn: 可是，下次我就不一定能见到她了……！
say:22:1320912017:1.male: B-but if I don't go now, I might never see her again...
say:22:1320912017:1.female: B-but if I don't go now, I might never see her again...

say:23:1320912020:0.text: Hmph! If you won't help me, fine! I'll do it myself!
say:23:1320912020:0.source_cn: 你们不愿意帮我也没关系……我一个人也能做到的！

choice:21:0:1.text: You need to go home now.
choice:21:0:1.source_cn: 现在太晚了，你得早点回家
choice:21:0:1.male: You need to go home now.
choice:21:0:1.female: You need to go home now.

say:27:1320912018:1.text: I'll never know unless I try! And I want to help her!
say:27:1320912018:1.male: I'll never know unless I try! And I want to help her!
say:27:1320912018:1.female: I'll never know unless I try! And I want to help her!

choice:21:1:2.text: But you don't know her wish.
choice:21:1:2.source_cn: 她的心愿你未必能实现
choice:21:1:2.male: But you don't know her wish.
choice:21:1:2.female: But you don't know her wish.

say:28:1320912019:1.text: Don't treat me like a baby!
say:28:1320912019:1.male: Don't treat me like a baby!
say:28:1320912019:1.female: Don't treat me like a baby!

choice:13:0:1.text: Why didn't you go home earlier?
choice:13:0:1.source_cn: 你为什么那么晚都没回家？
choice:13:0:1.male: Why didn't you go home earlier?
choice:13:0:1.female: Why didn't you go home earlier?

say:29:1320912007:0.text: Well... I heard footsteps behind me on my way home, and then they appeared...
say:29:1320912007:0.source_cn: 嗯……回家的时候，我听到背后有脚步声，然后就看到了活死人……
say:29:1320912007:0.male: Well... I heard footsteps behind me on my way home, and then they appeared...
say:29:1320912007:0.female: Well... I heard footsteps behind me on my way home, and then they appeared...

say:30:1320912008:1.text: The undead only come out at night, right? Why were you out so late?
say:30:1320912008:1.source_cn: 活死人出现的时候已经是晚上了吧？为什么这么晚才回家呀？

choice:13:1:2.text: How did you run into the undead?
choice:13:1:2.male: How did you run into the undead?
choice:13:1:2.female: How did you run into the undead?

choice:13:2:3.text: Who was that spirit just now?
choice:13:2:3.male: Who was that spirit just now?
choice:13:2:3.female: Who was that spirit just now?

narration:32:13020925:0.text: Naum praises your magic again and again, but the female spirit beside him seizes the chance and quickly floats away.
narration:32:13020925:0.source_cn: 瑙姆对你的魔法连连赞叹，但他身边的女幽灵却抓准机会，迅...

say:5:1320927001:0.text: At last, I've returned... to Cedartown.
say:5:1320927001:0.source_cn: 我终于回到这里了……雪松镇。

say:7:1320927002:0.text: I'm not an expert in the matters of the undead or souls, but if your son's spirit has ever returned here, you should feel it.
say:7:1320927002:0.source_cn: 唔，我不太清楚亡灵和灵魂方面的事。不过，如果你儿子的灵...

say:8:1320927003:1.text: Yes, I can feel it... His soul has not yet returned...
say:8:1320927003:1.source_cn: 对，我能感受到……他的灵魂，还没有回来……

choice_prompt:9:1320927003.text: Yes, I can feel it... His soul has not yet returned...
choice_prompt:9:1320927003.source_cn: 对，我能感受到……他的灵魂，还没有回来……

say:10:1320927005:0.text: I know... One day, he will come home to this place, and we'll be reunited, just as we once were.
say:10:1320927005:0.source_cn: 我知道……他总有一天会找到回家的路，回到这里，和我团聚……

say:12:1320927006:0.text: Yes! I believe it too, your son will definitely come back to you!
say:12:1320927006:0.source_cn: 嗯，瑙姆也相信……大婶的儿子一定会回来的！

say:13:1320927007:1.text: Thank you... Thank you, Naum, sir tomb guardian, and you, great mage...
say:13:1320927007:1.source_cn: 谢谢你们……瑙姆，巡墓人先生，还有魔法师大人……
say:13:1320927007:1.male: Thank you... Thank you, Naum, sir tomb guardian, and you, great mage...
say:13:1320927007:1.female: Thank you... Thank you, Naum, sir tomb guardian, and you, great mage...

say:14:1320927008:0.text: You've fulfilled my wish. I have no regrets now, no more longing...
say:14:1320927008:0.source_cn: 我的心愿已经完成，没有什么可遗憾的了……

say:15:1320927009:1.text: Goodbye, all of you. May your lives be free from regret, as mine finally is.
say:15:1320927009:1.source_cn: 再见了，几位……祝愿你们的人生，永远都没有遗憾……

narration:20:13020948:0.text: With the help of the caretaker, you move Ksenia's grave back to Cedartown.
narration:20:13020948:0.source_cn: 在巡墓人的帮助下，你们把克谢尼娅的墓迁回了雪松镇上。

choice:9:0:1.text: He'll find his way home someday.
choice:9:0:1.male: He'll find his way home someday.
choice:9:0:1.female: He'll find his way home someday.

say:21:1320927004:0.text: No, you've already given me more than I could ever ask for...
say:21:1320927004:0.source_cn: 不，不用了……你们已经帮助我很多了……

choice:9:1:2.text: Want us to help search for him?
choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 需要我们帮你找到他吗？
choice:9:1:2.male: Want us to help search for him?
choice:9:1:2.female: Want us to help search for him?

narration:22:13020948:0.text: With the help of the caretaker, you move Ksenia's grave back to Cedartown.
narration:22:13020948:0.source_cn: 在巡墓人的帮助下，你们把克谢尼娅的墓迁回了雪松镇上。
